## Summary

Complete the intent of #100, #103 and #101 against the merged fifth-round remediation (#102).

- Add explicit `PreparedScriptView::mount_window` native authority delegation. Ordinary embedded mounts stay disabled. A weak lease enforces one command owner per actual GPUI window, including across Host aliases; failed mounts/dispose/native closure clean it up.
- Register real native handles and close policy, and share deferred native focus/close execution to avoid same-window reentry. Window closure also disposes externally retained view handles.
- Preserve PR #101's authored fix and finish RTL via shared `inset_start`/`inset_end` style resolution. Final/sole columns are resizable; separator focus refs are distinct from header measurement refs.
- Fix the full Gallery default-stack overflow found during integration: private UiNode styles become immutable shared snapshots with copy-on-write. UiNode is 592 bytes rather than inlining a 5680-byte Style. Shared/default/modified/ghost snapshots keep isolation.
- Update USER_GUIDE, embedding/multi-window guides and the pending 0.1.8 notes. Add verification evidence without touching the user's separate PR-triage material.

## Verification

- Workspace 616 tests; all-feature core 480; default core 450.
- Native product workspace: 155 tests, on the default thread stack.
- Native window owner tests cover real focus activation, child open/close, confirmation, default denial, same/cross-Host ownership conflicts, rollback/remount, wrong-window binding and retained-handle disposal.
- Deferred native commands recheck source/target authority before execution; disposing an owner cancels its queued close and cannot bypass a replacement owner's confirmation.
- Table tests cover actual LTR/RTL geometry, Array/NativeCollection dragging, final/sole columns, autofit, mixed resizable neighbors and physical keyboard arrows focused on the native ref.
- Strict workspace/native Clippy, fmt, public rustdoc, performance structure, target manifest, package gates, complete macOS release smoke and artifact audit pass.

Detailed record: `docs/audits/2026-10-02-window-table-adapters/report.zh-CN.md`.

## Remaining gate

Fixed-viewport Data Table screenshots are not refreshed: the desktop window manager tiled the visible test window to 825×1393 instead of 980×752. The old PNGs are unchanged, and a user prompt asks whether to temporarily float the one test window. Actual native geometry tests do not substitute for this visual step. No package publication/tag or independent acceptance is claimed.

This supersedes the constructor-only #100 and manual-registry #103 proposals with one complete explicit mount adapter, and includes #101's authored commit plus the RTL completion. Original PRs remain unmerged pending this successor's CI/review.
title: feat(runtime): complete embedded window authority and RTL table boundaries
